name: year
observations: Derived from date. Partition column. Null for the few stops whose agency recorded no date

name: state_abbreviation
description: Two-letter postal abbreviation of the state
observations: Taken from the source file name. Partition column of the staging files

name: state_id
description: Two-digit FIPS code of the state
observations: Not in the source. Added by Data Basis from state_abbreviation

name: jurisdiction_id
description: Identifier of the jurisdiction whose agency recorded the stop, in the form state_place, e.g. ca_san_diego or tx_statewide
observations: Taken from the source file name. One source file per jurisdiction. Join to the jurisdiction table for its name and type

name: raw_row_number
description: Row number of the record in the agency's raw file, used to join the standardized data back to the raw data
observations: Where the project merged several raw rows into one stop, holds their raw row numbers joined by a pipe

name: date
observations: Where the agency reports only the year or quarter, set to the first day of that period. Null for the few stops whose agency recorded no date

name: location
description: Free-text location of the stop, e.g. a street address or highway mile marker
observations: Sometimes the concatenation of several raw fields, such as street number and street name

name: lat
observations: Provided by the agency or geocoded by the project from the location. Geocodes more than 4 standard deviations from the jurisdiction's median were set to null

name: lng
observations: Provided by the agency or geocoded by the project from the location. Geocodes more than 4 standard deviations from the jurisdiction's median were set to null

name: geocode_source
description: Geocoding service used for lat and lng: GM for Google Maps, SGC for the Stanford Geospatial Center
observations: Only filled for the jurisdictions refreshed in the 2023 release

name: county_name
description: Name of the county where the stop took place

name: neighborhood
observations: Some agencies report a neighborhood instead of a location or beat

name: beat
observations: Police geography as recorded by the agency or, where the project had the department's shapefiles and the stop's coordinates, assigned by spatial join

name: subject_age
observations: Computed from the date of birth and the stop date where the agency reports a date of birth, so it can be fractional. Values outside 10-110 set to null

name: subject_race
description: Race of the stopped person: white, black, hispanic, asian/pacific islander, other or unknown
observations: Standardized by the project from the agency's own categories

name: subject_sex
description: Recorded sex of the stopped person: male or female

name: officer_id_hash
description: Hash of the officer's identifier, unique to one officer within a jurisdiction
observations: The badge number itself is withheld by the project for privacy. Where badge numbers are not unique (South Carolina statewide, Seattle) the hash also uses other officer attributes. Not comparable across jurisdictions

name: officer_age
observations: Computed from the date of birth and the stop date where available. Values outside 10-100 set to null

name: officer_race
description: Race of the officer: white, black, hispanic, asian/pacific islander, other or unknown

name: officer_sex
description: Recorded sex of the officer: male or female

name: officer_years_of_service
description: Years the officer has served in the department

name: officer_assignment
description: Department or subdivision to which the officer is assigned
observations: Free text as recorded by the agency; format varies across jurisdictions

name: department_id
description: Identifier of the department or subdivision to which the officer is assigned

name: department_name
description: Name of the department or subdivision to which the officer is assigned

name: unit
description: Unit to which the officer is assigned
observations: Free text as recorded by the agency; format varies across jurisdictions

name: type
description: Type of stop: vehicular or pedestrian

name: disposition
observations: Free text as recorded by the agency; format varies across jurisdictions

name: violation
description: Violation for which the person was stopped
observations: Free text as recorded by the agency; format varies across jurisdictions. Multiple violations are separated by a pipe

name: arrest_made
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it

name: citation_issued
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it

name: warning_issued
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it

name: outcome
description: Strictest action taken among arrest, citation, summons and warning

name: contraband_found
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Set to null by the project where search_conducted is null

name: contraband_drugs
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Only defined when contraband_found is TRUE

name: contraband_weapons
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Only defined when contraband_found is TRUE

name: contraband_alcohol
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Only defined when contraband_found is TRUE

name: contraband_other
description: Whether contraband other than drugs and weapons was found
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Only defined when contraband_found is TRUE

name: frisk_performed
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. A frisk is distinct from a search, but some agencies record frisks as a search type

name: search_conducted
description: Whether any search was conducted, of a driver, passenger or vehicle
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Excludes frisks where the agency distinguishes the two

name: search_person
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Only defined when search_conducted is TRUE

name: search_vehicle
observations: Source values TRUE/FALSE kept as text; empty when the agency does not record it. Only defined when search_conducted is TRUE

name: search_basis
description: Basis for the search: k9, plain view, consent, probable cause or other
observations: Where a search happened but no reason was recorded, the project assumes probable cause

name: reason_for_arrest
observations: Free text as recorded by the agency; format varies across jurisdictions
